title: CE-MS/MS Tutorial Dataset for MS-DIAL5
author: Kiuchi, Saki
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Gather dataset files
steps.instruction: Create a folder containing all tutorial files: the raw CE‑MS/MS data file (*.raw) acquired from mouse RAW264.7 macrophage cells on a Q Exactive Plus (Thermo Fisher) with vDIA, the output files named 20230208_* and AlignmentResult_20240126_18_*, the internal‑standard text library (*.txt), and the MS/MS spectral library file MSMS-Public_all-neg-VS18.msp located in the library subfolder; also note the acquisition hardware (CE System 7100, Agilent 1260 isocratic HPLC pump).

steps.title: Open MS‑DIAL project
steps.instruction: Launch MS‑DIAL, then open the project file 2024_01_26_18_09_19.mdprject.

steps.title: Verify required files are present
steps.instruction: Confirm that the MS‑DIAL analysis output files 20230208_* and AlignmentResult_20240126_18_* reside in the same folder as the opened project file; if any are missing, copy them into that folder before proceeding.

steps.title: Run tutorial analysis
steps.instruction: Follow the step‑by‑step tutorial instructions within MS‑DIAL to process the data, perform alignment, annotate metabolites using the provided txt and .msp libraries, and reproduce the tutorial results.
